newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commercials, locals, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commercials, locals, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commercial and local selling and lower CBOT soycomplex values, traders said.
"We followed Chicago. Locals sold all day and into the close, Cargill sold 100 January," a trader said. "Exporters are bought every fifty cents down through UGG," he said.
About 1,500 Nov-Jan spread at $4.80 and May-July at $1.50. November futures crush margin rose to -34.21 from -35.84. Volume was 5,830 lots, 350 hedges.
Japan bought 2,000 tonnes of cash canola, sources said.
November flax fell $0.50 to $360.50. About 300 Nov-Jan spread at $3.50. Volume was 755 lots, 60 hedges.

November western barley lost $0.90 to $140 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold and commission houses liquidated longs, traders said. November and February set new lows. Nov-Oct spread at $0.50, Nov-Feb $2.30, May-Oct $4. Volume 2,500.
December feed wheat futures rose $1.50 to $168.70 on commercial buying and Dec-Mar spreading at $1. Volume was 1,000. Cargill bought 39 December peas up US$0.50 to US$198.50, traders said.
(Values in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas, oats).
